Name: Enchanted Wardrobe - Equipment Forge and Rune System
Author: Natateto
Description:
[heading]Overview[/heading]
[b]Enchanted Wardrobe[/b] adds RPG-style equipment progression to Stardew Valley.
Hats, shirts, pants, boots, and melee weapons can receive randomized rarities, bonus affixes, rune sockets, and special effects.
Collect runes and Arcane Fiber from defeated monsters, then use the Equipment Forge to develop your favorite gear through fusion, dismantling, reforging, socketing, and rune fusion.
[b]Keep the equipment you love and build it into something powerful![/b]
[heading][b]Features[/b][/heading]
[b]Equipment Rarity and Random Affixes
Supported equipment:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Hats[/b][/*]
[*][b]Shirts[/b][/*]
[*][b]Pants[/b][/*]
[*][b]Boots[/b][/*]
[*][b]Melee weapons (swords, daggers, clubs, and supported modded melee weapons)[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Scythes are excluded.
Equipment can receive five random rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary.
Higher rarities offer more affixes, stronger stat ranges, and additional rune sockets. Duplicate affixes are allowed.
Mythic rarity is reserved for future content and cannot be obtained through normal random rolls or fusion.
Equipment Forge
Fusion
Combine three items of the same rarity to create an item of the next rarity.
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]The first item keeps its appearance and identity.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Choose one affix type from the base item to inherit.[/b][/*]
[*][b]The inherited affix value is rerolled for the resulting rarity.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Material affixes increase the weighting of matching result affixes.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Melee weapons must be fused with melee weapons.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Clothing must be fused with clothing.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Remove all runes/shards from material items before fusion.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Three Legendary items produce another Legendary item, not Mythic.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Dismantle
Destroy unwanted equipment to obtain Arcane Fiber. The amount depends on equipment rarity.
All socketed materials must be removed before dismantling.
Reforge
Select the affixes you want to LOCK. All unselected affixes are rerolled.
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Selected affixes remain unchanged.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Unselected affixes are rerolled.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Affix + Value: rerolls both type and value.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Value Only: rerolls the value while preserving the type.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Zero locked affixes: reroll everything.[/b][/*]
[*][b]All affixes locked: cannot reforge.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Locking more affixes increases Arcane Fiber cost.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Socket
Insert runes or Prismatic Shards into equipment sockets.
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Runes can be removed and reused freely.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Prismatic Shards grant a random combat enchantment.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Prismatic Shards are destroyed when removed.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Socket capacity depends on equipment rarity.[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Rune Fusion
Combine three runes of the same type and tier to create one rune of the next tier.
Rune tiers range from 1 to 5. Tier 5 is the maximum.
No additional gold or materials are required.
Enhance
Reserved for a future update and currently unavailable.
Arcane Fiber
Arcane Fiber is a resource obtained through monster drops and equipment dismantling.
It is primarily used for reforging equipment.
The more affixes you protect during reforging, the higher the material cost.[/b]

[/list][b]Lifesteal
Successful damaging hits restore HP based on damage dealt. If the calculated healing amount is below 1, at least 1 HP is restored.
A healing animation and sound play when HP is restored. Lifesteal does not activate on misses or at full health.
Time Rune Compatibility
Reduces cooldowns for supported external mods.
Currently includes Sword Mastery basic skills and Ohgi abilities. Compatibility with every skill mod is not guaranteed.

[*][b]Crusader[/b][/*]
[*][b]Vampiric[/b][/*]
[*][b]Haymaker[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Equipped shard effects are applied as temporary combat enchantments to the currently held melee weapon.
Removing the shard destroys it and removes its effect.[/b]

[b]Equipment Stats Window
A new Equipment Stats button is available in the inventory.
The window displays the combined bonuses from equipped clothing and the currently held melee weapon, including:
Attack Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Attack Speed, Defense, Max Health, Damage Reduction, Dodge Chance, Movement Speed, Luck, HP Recovery, Lifesteal, Stamina Recovery, and Compatible Mod Cooldown Reduction.
Weapons stored in the backpack do not contribute bonuses.
Long equipment descriptions can be scrolled inside the details panel.
[/b]

[heading][b]소개[/b][/heading]
[b]**Enchanted Wardrobe(마력의 옷장)**는 스타듀밸리의 모자, 상의, 하의, 신발, 근접 무기에 RPG 스타일의 장비 성장 시스템을 추가하는 모드입니다.
장비를 획득하면 무작위 등급과 추가 능력치가 부여됩니다. 몬스터를 사냥하여 룬과 마력섬유를 얻고, 장비 공방에서 좋아하는 장비를 합성·재련하거나 소켓에 룬을 장착할 수 있습니다.
기존 장비의 외형을 유지하면서 자신만의 장비 빌드를 완성하세요!
[/b]
[heading][b]주요 기능[/b][/heading]
[b]1. 장비 등급과 무작위 옵션
지원 장비:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]모자[/b][/*]
[*][b]상의[/b][/*]
[*][b]하의[/b][/*]
[*][b]신발[/b][/*]
[*][b]근접 무기(검, 단검, 둔기 등)[/b][/*]
[/list][b]낫은 제외됩니다.
모든 지원 장비에는 일반, 고급, 희귀, 영웅, 전설의 5가지 무작위 등급이 존재합니다.
등급이 높아질수록 옵션 개수와 능력치 수치 범위가 증가합니다. 같은 능력치가 중복 등장할 수도 있습니다.
신화 등급은 향후 콘텐츠를 위해 예약되어 있으며 일반적인 무작위 획득 및 합성으로 생성되지 않습니다.
2. 장비 공방(Equipment Forge)
합성(Fusion)
동일 등급 장비 3개를 사용하여 상위 등급 장비를 제작합니다.
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]첫 번째 장비의 외형과 기본 아이템 유지[/b][/*]
[*][b]첫 번째 장비에서 선택한 옵션 1종 확정 계승[/b][/*]
[*][b]계승 옵션의 수치는 결과 등급에 맞게 재추첨[/b][/*]
[*][b]재료 장비들의 옵션 종류가 추가 옵션 추첨에 영향을 줌[/b][/*]
[*][b]무기는 무기끼리, 의류는 의류끼리 합성[/b][/*]
